method: Actual STL first intersected by radial or lateral rays, then a second inward ray is cast along the actual outer triangle normal to find the paired inner exit. No mother/head topology correspondence is assumed. Ear samples choose innermost lateral material pair to bypass pinna. Cut-plane +/-3mm and magnet/pin neighborhoods excluded from ordinary-cranium sampling.
limitations: Discrete surface-normal crossing measurements; not a certified global minimum wall thickness or print/material strength guarantee. Grazing rays, intentional openings, seam faces and complex ear folds require separate interpretation.
source_ear_classification: Actual outer hit is matched to 32 nearest-centroid mother triangles and exact closest point; majority source-ear incidence and surface distance<0.5mm identifies original pinna skin. Raw ear-region minima remain reported separately; ear-skin thickness is not claimed as hollow-cranium wall thickness.

head:ordinary_cranium.validity_rule: exit normal dot entry normal < -0.25 and crossing <8mm; other crossings retained as ambiguous/mechanical, not called wall minima
